name: ai-cli-launcher
description: Launch the Antigravity, Grok, Qoder, Qoder CN, OpenCode, Claude and Codex CLIs from the status bar. Each click opens a new terminal tab running that CLI.

aiCli.terminalLocation.description: Where new CLI terminals open. "editor" gives the full-screen TUI a larger viewport at the cost of covering the current file.

aiCli.agy.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Antigravity CLI (`agy`). Leave empty to look it up on `PATH`, then in `/opt/homebrew/bin`.

aiCli.agy.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments appended when launching `agy`. Set `["--new-project"]` to force a fresh project session on every click.

aiCli.agy.enabled.description: Show the Antigravity CLI entry in the status bar.

aiCli.agy.codicon.markdownDescription: Status bar icon for Antigravity, as a stock codicon name such as `rocket`. The status bar cannot render images, so brand SVGs are not accepted here. Leave empty to fall back to `rocket`.

aiCli.grok.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Grok CLI (`grok`). Leave empty to look it up on `PATH`, then in `~/.grok/bin`.

aiCli.grok.enabled.description: Show the Grok CLI entry in the status bar.

aiCli.grok.codicon.markdownDescription: Status bar icon for Grok, as a stock codicon name such as `rocket`. The status bar cannot render images, so brand SVGs are not accepted here. Leave empty to fall back to `sparkle`.

aiCli.qoder.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Qoder CLI (`qodercli`). Leave empty to look it up on `PATH`, then in `~/.local/bin`. ⚠️ Do **not** point this at `~/.qoder/entry/qoder`: that wrapper launches the Qoder IDE when given any argument.

aiCli.qoder.enabled.description: Show the Qoder CLI entry in the status bar.

aiCli.qoder.codicon.markdownDescription: Status bar icon for Qoder, as a stock codicon name such as `rocket`. The status bar cannot render images, so brand SVGs are not accepted here. Leave empty to fall back to `hubot`.

aiCli.qodercn.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Qoder CN CLI (`qoderclicn`). Leave empty to look it up on `PATH`, then in `~/.local/bin`. Point it at the `qoderclicn` binary, not at a wrapper under `~/.qoder-cn/entry`.

aiCli.qodercn.enabled.description: Show the Qoder CN CLI entry in the status bar.

aiCli.qodercn.codicon.markdownDescription: Status bar icon for Qoder CN, as a stock codicon name such as `rocket`. The status bar cannot render images, so brand SVGs are not accepted here. Leave empty to fall back to `robot`.

aiCli.opencode.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the OpenCode CLI (`opencode`). Leave empty to look it up on `PATH`, then in `/opt/homebrew/bin`.

aiCli.opencode.enabled.description: Show the OpenCode CLI entry in the status bar.

aiCli.opencode.codicon.markdownDescription: Status bar icon for OpenCode, as a stock codicon name such as `rocket`. The status bar cannot render images, so brand SVGs are not accepted here. Leave empty to fall back to `bracket-dot`.

aiCli.claude.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to Claude Code (`claude`). Leave empty to look it up on `PATH`.

aiCli.claude.enabled.description: Show the Claude Code CLI entry in the status bar.

aiCli.claude.codicon.markdownDescription: Status bar icon for Claude Code, as a stock codicon name such as `rocket`. The status bar cannot render images, so brand SVGs are not accepted here. Leave empty to fall back to `flame`.

aiCli.codex.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Codex CLI (`codex`). Leave empty to look it up on `PATH`.

aiCli.codex.enabled.description: Show the Codex CLI entry in the status bar.

aiCli.codex.codicon.markdownDescription: Status bar icon for Codex, as a stock codicon name such as `rocket`. The status bar cannot render images, so brand SVGs are not accepted here. Leave empty to fall back to `book`.
